# Version 1 compatibility fixtures

These fixtures test structural interoperability; their byte strings are public test values, not secrets or production randomness. A conforming implementation runs every valid case through deterministic CBOR encode/decode and rejects every invalid case with the named stable category.

`canonical-primitives.json` pins exact lowercase CBOR hex. Other files use the semantic fixture notation from `schema/formats.md`; cryptographic authenticity is intentionally outside their scope and receives golden vectors with the cryptographic core.

`crypto-identity.json` pins X25519 anonymous sealed-box and domain-separated Ed25519 signature outputs generated from explicitly public fixed randomness. `crypto-aead.json` pins canonical keybag/object AAD and exact XChaCha20-Poly1305 outputs with public fixture keys and nonces. `crypto-attachment.json` pins a private HMAC blob ID plus manifest/chunk AAD, ciphertext, and diagnostic hash. `crypto-backup.json` pins the complete immutable backup AAD and archive ciphertext. `keystore-envelope.json` pins the cross-platform `BKW1` header and metadata binding while using placeholder platform ciphertext. `yjs-updates.json` pins official V1/V2 Y.Text update bytes generated by `yjs@13.6.30` and distributed with the selected `github.com/reearth/ygo` v1.48.0 release.
